newsitem.title: USA: Hooper Holmes stake held by Cumberland.
newsitem.headline: Hooper Holmes stake held by Cumberland.

text.p: Cumberland Associates said on Monday it holds a 5.9 percent stake in Hooper Holmes Inc or 394,700 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Cumberland said its latest transactions include the purchase of 263,300 common shares between January 23 and March 5 at prices ranging from $15.50 to $16.50 per share.
Cumberland said it holds the stake for investment purposes.
Hooper Holmes, based in Basking Ridge, N.J., provides medical and other underwriting information on insurance policy applicants to major companies in the life and health insurance industry.
